name: io.github.atomno-mcp/mcp-newbuild
title: mcp-newbuild
description: New-build MCP on the client's EISZHS contract. Spec is closed.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NEWBUILD_EISZHS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id from the client's EISZHS API contract.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NEWBUILD_EISZHS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: client_secret from the client's EISZHS API contract.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NEWBUILD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional key for Atomno hosted placement. Not an EISZHS key.
